prompt:
Generate ONE large high-resolution Korean production storyboard sheet, landscape 4:3, EXACTLY 12 numbered panels in 4 columns x 3 rows, read left to right. Highest available resolution, crisp Korean. Clean white/cream editorial borders with small mint/coral headings; images occupy most of sheet. Title "우주에서 받은 신호, 대구에서 만난 친구". Subtitle "성체 원본 기준 · 캐러셀 12장 = 영상 12컷 · 무대사 · 실사 + 캐릭터 CG". Top-right "대사투 페스티벌(가칭) / 두류 야외음악당 / v03". This is a practical storyboard, not actual filmed event documentation.

CRITICAL STYLE: photoreal LIVE-ACTION Korean festival backgrounds, REAL HUMAN adults and children with realistic human faces, realistic grass, trees, metal stage, photographic food, fabric clothing, paper cups, stainless cookware, real market vendors and tables. ONLY blue cat mascot, green dog mascot, spaceship and fantasy planet are stylized smooth CG composited seamlessly into footage, matching sunlight, contact shadows, reflections, lens depth and perspective. Absolutely no cartoon/3D toy people or toy scenery. Cinematic real commercial with CG characters, 35mm photography, natural Korean afternoon. Mascots about 1 metre tall beside normal human adults 1.6–1.8m.

REFERENCE ROLES:
1 = adult blue alien CAT DAEKIMI identity, keep original wide head, pink inner triangular ears, exact star-eye motifs, two ball-tip antennae, PINK RIBBON ON CURLED TAIL ONLY.
2 = adult green alien DOG OEJIMONG primary approved FRONT identity.
3 = brand logo for footer/merch branding only.
4 = CLOSED spaceship design, correct flying silhouette green and cream with floppy ear side pods and transparent canopy.
5 = Eollastar coral fantasy planet with mint ring, only shot01 outer space.
6 = OEJIMONG approved front/45/profile reference: use it for exact HEAD DEPTH, floppy-ear shape and consistent face proportions.
7 = OEJIMONG approved pose/pads reference: exact BODY MASS and proportions; palm/sole pads ONLY when surface visible, one main and 3 small pads. Do not apply pads to hand backs.
8 = OPEN SPACESHIP SIX-VIEW MECHANISM, use strictly in shot04: ENTIRE clear canopy hinged UP ABOVE cockpit, cream padded single seat exposed, central FRONT stair-ladder folded DOWN onto ground, narrow green rails and cream steps, green/cream body stays intact, NO side door, NO giant cutout in side fuselage, NO generic hinged car door. Pilot exits via front ladder.
OEJIMONG STRICT: consistent grown-up reference proportions, no baby/chibi redesign, huge rounded triangular black eyes with a large white four-point star, small grey star and tiny diamond per eye, cream muzzle bounded around nose/mouth only, black rounded inverted-triangle nose, two ball-tip antennae only, large drooping GREEN ears, cream nearly round vertical belly patch SINGLE flat patch (not protruding belly plate), thick rounded green tail with small cream tip via soft gradient; tail is not white root or fluffy pompom. Smooth low-gloss skin, no fur/blush/new clothing, arms/legs short rounded like refs, no human fingers. Height to antenna top OEJIMONG105cm vs DAEKIMI103cm, nearly same; dog marginally taller at equal distance, NEVER miniature dog beside oversized blue cat. Keep their face geometry and body silhouettes consistent across all12. Do not borrow toy/plush proportions for main characters.

LOCATION: Duryu Park Kolon Outdoor Music Hall Daegu, broad realistic green lawn, treeline and modern low stage with wide shallow slanted steel/glass canopy, brick side structures, distant 83 Tower where natural. Fictional festival tents along lawn perimeter with realistic Korean visitors and vendors. Stage banner exact "대사투 페스티벌". Translator is provisional cream/mint handheld device. Symbol-only speech bubbles "…", "?", "!" can be graphic overlays, never spoken words. No audio dialogue or narration; stage debate is conveyed visually with human contestants at opposite lecterns, moderator, gestures and audience.

For EACH card use EXACT short header and one caption OUTSIDE image, not floating explanatory paragraphs in scene:
01 "우주 항해 | 00–05초": CG green/cream CLOSED spaceship piloted by green dog flying between distant Eollastar and PHOTOREAL Earth in black starry space. Caption "얼라별을 떠나 지구로 향한다."
02 "신호 수신 | 05–10초": cockpit closeup green dog notices signal waveform on built-in dashboard, Earth outside, '?' bubble. Caption "지구 위에서 낯선 신호를 받는다."
03 "대한민국 상공 | 10–15초": SINGLE full-frame photoreal orbital oblique aerial view of ENTIRE recognizable Korean peninsula, seas, southern inland Daegu. CG ship floating ABOVE SOUTH KOREA, a small luminous signal ripple RISES FROM DAEGU LOCATION on the actual terrain up toward ship. NO inset, NO floating map, NO circular map, NO split screen, NO navigation window, NO holographic mini-earth. A tiny '대구' terrain label okay. Caption "대구에서 올라오는 신호를 따라간다."

Shop sign '대구 얼라들'. Distinguish merchandise toys from main adult mascots. Caption "사투리 티셔츠부터 키링까지 구경한다."
12 "대구에서 생긴 친구 | 61–66초": rear three-quarter CG friends walking together across real lawn toward photoreal outdoor music hall with real visitors, tails accurate cat ribbon on tail, green dog's cream tail tip, warm afternoon. Caption "표현이 달라도, 친구가 된다."

Footer small clear type: "캐러셀 01–12와 영상 01–12 동일 내용·순서 / 66초 편집안 / 음성 대사 없음 / 말풍선·간판·로고 후편집". Small logo at bottom right. Put "번역기·상품 문구는 콘셉트" discreetly. STRICT 12 panels, exact shot03 direct peninsula not inset, shot04 hinged canopy and front ladder, shot05 human debate, shot10 tasting food, shot11 diverse dialect goods.
